senses.gloss:
r. 4th cl. (बुस्यति)
To dismiss, to loose, to quit or leave.

n. (-सं)
1 Chaff.
2 Wealth.
3 Dry cow-dung.
4 The thick part of sour curds.
f. (-सा)
A younger sister, (in theatrical language.)
E.
बुस to abandon, aff. क; also बुष, स being changed to ष.

r. 10th cl. (बुस्तयति)
1 To regard, to respect.
2 To disregard, to treat with disrespect.

n. (-स्तं)
1 Force-meat ball.
2 Fried meat.
3 The inner part of the jack fruit.
E.
बुस्त to disrespect, aff. अच्.
